mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a fair 70 degrees near Verona Area High School.
City tax bills will be mailed by December 15. You can pay your installments online via the City of Verona website or by using the 24/7 drop boxes located at the City Center.

There is plenty to do in Verona! Today, you can join trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, or Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow, look forward to yoga at Insight Wellness or pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee.
Looking at the weekly police report, on November 6, officers responded to a business on West Verona Avenue where they found a driver passed out in their vehicle, leading to an arrest for O W I.
Today's flavor at Culver's is O R E O R E E S E S Cheesecake. The restaurant is currently open and will remain open until 10 PM tonight.
